qa_pair.question: In the synthetic evaluation account, identify the application with the earliest September 2024 interview. Read its submitted resume snapshot rather than its current resume. What employer appears in that snapshot? Return only the employer name.
Find the application linked to the resume using alex.cedar@example.test. What follow-up timestamp was recorded for it? Return UTC as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ.

Find the application whose linked resume lists Summit Analytics as its employer. Compare its submitted cover-letter snapshot with the current letter. What reporting-time reduction percentage was claimed in the submitted letter? Return only the integer.

Among applications with September 2024 interviews, compare each submitted resume snapshot with its current resume. Which company's submitted resume shows a different employer from its current resume? Return only the company name.

Find the application without a linked cover letter. Compare its stored job requirements with keywords in its linked resume's skill section. Which required technology is absent? Return only its exact name.
Find the application whose submitted cover letter describes improving delivery reliability. What is the UTC start timestamp of its September 2024 technical interview? Return YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ.
Find the application whose submitted cover letter describes improving delivery reliability. How long was its September 2024 interview scheduled to last? Return only minutes as an integer.
Identify the application whose submitted resume lists Kafka in its skill keywords. What is the email address of its recruiter contact? Return only the address.

Inspect all applications and their submitted resume snapshots. Sum September 2024 interview durations for applications whose submitted resume lists Harbor Systems as employer. Return total minutes as an integer.

Identify the application whose submitted cover letter claims a reporting-time improvement. Find the named baseline version of its linked resume. What is that version's user-authored name? Return only the name.
